alerts.text: _diffrn_measured_fraction_theta_full value Low .      0.907 Why?

kb.meaning: _diffrn_measured_fraction_theta_full 偏低
kb.causes: 数据完整度不足（常见于高角缺失或探测器几何）
kb.remedy: 报告真实完整度并解释（如低温机遮挡、快速衰减晶体）

alerts.text: Missing _cell_measurement_reflns_used Value ....     Please Do !

kb.meaning: 缺 _cell_measurement_reflns_used
kb.causes: 未记录晶胞测定用的反射数（来自指标化软件）
kb.remedy: 从数据处理软件（SAINT/CrysAlis/DIALS）提取，或如实留空并说明

alerts.text: Missing _cell_measurement_theta_min Value ......     Please Do !

alerts.text: Missing _exptl_crystal_description Value .......     Please Do !

kb.remedy: 补 experiment.crystal

alerts.text: No Datum for _diffrn_reflns_av_R_equivalents ...     Please Do !

kb.meaning: Report missing datum for_diffrn_reflns_av_R_equivalents.

alerts.text: Can not Recreate .fcf from Embedded  .res & .hkl          ! Check

kb.meaning: 无法从内嵌 .res+.hkl 复算 .fcf
kb.causes: 精修含 .fab（掩膜）贡献而 fab 未内嵌，PLATON 复算必然不一致
kb.remedy: 随附 final.fab 或说明掩膜工作流；这是掩膜结构的已知提示

alerts.text: Info on Absorption Correction Method   Not Given     Please Do !

kb.meaning: Test for specification absorption correction method [0,1].
kb.remedy: 在CIF文件中"_exptl_absorpt_correction_type"项给出吸收校正方法即可。若未做吸收校正，此项填写'none'或'?'，并将"_exptl_absorpt_correction_T_max"、"_exptl_absorpt_correction_T_min"和"_exptl_absorpt_process_details"项内容改为'?'即可。

alerts.text: Minimum Crystal Dimension Missing (or Error) ...     Please Check

kb.meaning: Test for specification xtal_dimension_min[0,1].
kb.remedy: 在_exptl_crystal_size_min项中给出晶体最小尺寸，单位为毫米。或者在ins中添加SIZE指令后精修。

alerts.text: Medium  Crystal Dimension Missing (or Error) ...     Please Check

kb.meaning: Test for specification xtal_dimension_mid [0,1].
kb.remedy: 在_exptl_crystal_size_mid项中给出晶体中间尺寸，单位为毫米。或者在ins中添加SIZE指令后精修。

alerts.text: Maximum Crystal Dimension Missing (or Error) ...     Please Check

kb.meaning: Test for specification xtal_dimension_max [0,1].
kb.remedy: 在_exptl_crystal_size_max项中给出晶体最大尺寸，单位为毫米。或者在ins中添加SIZE指令后精修。

kb.meaning: 同种元素 Ueq 最大/最小比值大
kb.causes: 骨架 O 与端配/羟基 O 热运动差异；或有判错原子
kb.remedy: 核对每个高 U 原子的密度支持与配位环境后说明
